name: FirstOrderFilter
description: A first-order low-pass filter simulation block that smooths an input signal using a time constant tau. It uses a discrete-time update rule based on the coefficient dt/(tau+dt) to blend the previous output with the current input.
source_code:
class FirstOrderFilter(FunctionBlock):
    def step(self, inputs, parameters, dt):
        value = inputs["value"]
        tau = parameters["tau"]
        initial = parameters["initial"]
        prev = self.state.get("prev", initial)
        coeff = dt / (tau + dt)
        out = prev + coeff * (value - prev)
        self.state["prev"] = out
        return out
